title: Glitch before and after on the motion promo
caption: The glitch look on the opening headline of the motion promo, shown as a split screen: the left half is clean, the right half carries the red and blue channel shift and the flickering grain.
prompt: Give the opening headline of ../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4 (1 s to 7 s) a digital glitch look at intensity 0.3 with a 10 px chromatic red/blue shift plus light grain. Then make a before/after split: left half the clean clip, right half the glitched one, a thin cream divider and small "Before" and "After: glitch" labels in Geist from fonts/ (labels.svg).
commands: ffmpeg -i work/source.mp4 -i work/glitch.mp4 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "[0:v]crop=960:1080:0:0[l];[1:v]crop=960:1080:960:0[r];[l][r]hstack=inputs=2,drawbox=x=958:y=0:w=4:h=1080:color=0xf0eadf:t=fill[c];[c][2:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium work/compare.mp4
